sections.title_zh: 01 · 第一次使用：先走通一篇文章
sections.zh: 你的任务是把论文中的信息核对成可追溯的数据。AI 预填是草稿；遇到不懂的化学问题可以保留疑点并请教负责人，不需要靠猜测完成。
sections.en: Your task is to turn paper content into traceable, checked records. AI prefill is a draft. Keep uncertainty visible and ask your supervisor when chemistry is unclear; do not guess to finish.

zh: 使用负责人提供的网址和 Reviewer 账号登录，从“我的任务”打开已分配文章。先核对题名与 DOI；Preview 横幅表示预览环境，练习与正式任务要分清。
先读摘要、主要图表、合成 Scheme 和结论，理解作者研究什么靶点、从哪些分子开始、重点推进哪些分子。第一次不必立刻修改所有字段。
按“文章信息 → 化合物与结构 → Lineage → 检查与提交”走一遍。先做一个 Compound：核对编号、结构、来源图、Activity；再检查它所在的 Lineage 和 Edge。
每次只处理一项，保存后确认页面显示新内容。表单中的格式示例不是论文数据；不要直接保存示例。
完成一组后复查疑点和来源，最后处理整篇覆盖与提交检查。先在负责人提供的教学任务中练习；实际文章里不要新增本手册的虚构分子。
en: Sign in with the supplied Reviewer account and open an assigned paper from My tasks. Match the title and DOI. A Preview banner identifies the preview environment; distinguish training from real assignments.
Read the abstract, main figures/tables, synthesis schemes and conclusion to identify the target, starting compounds and authors’ priorities. You do not need to edit every field immediately.
Follow Article information → Compounds and structures → Lineage → Review & submit. Start with one Compound: label, structure, source image and Activity; then inspect its Lineage and Edges.
Work on one item at a time. Save and verify the updated display. Placeholder examples are not paper data and must not be saved as facts.

Check uncertainties and sources for each group before checking whole-paper coverage and submission. Practise in a training assignment supplied by your supervisor, never by inserting this guide’s fictional molecules into a real paper.

blocks.zh: 本手册截图来自真实工作台界面，但使用虚构教学数据。图中数值、编号和研究结论仅用于学习操作。截图按钮会随中英文切换；正文保留 Compound 等常见字段名称，方便对照。
blocks.en: Screenshots show the real workbench with fictional teaching data. Values, labels and research statements illustrate operation only. Screenshots match each guide’s interface language; common field names are retained for comparison.

blocks.zh: 认清五个主要页签：文章信息、化合物与结构、活性对比、Lineage、检查与提交。上方的区段状态、已查看进度和科学审核状态用途不同，后文分别解释。
blocks.en: Find the five main tabs: Article information, Compounds and structures, Activity comparison, Lineage, and Check and submit. Section status, viewing progress and scientific review status serve different purposes, explained below.

blocks.zh: 撤销 / 重做作用于已保存的编辑，并记录新的操作历史。先保存或取消当前未保存编辑。其他会话或 AI 更新、提交及任务状态变化后，旧撤销链会停止，避免覆盖新内容。
blocks.en: Undo / redo restores saved edits and appends history. Save or cancel pending local edits first. Other sessions, AI updates, submissions and workflow changes stop the older undo chain to protect newer content.

sections.zh: 先把“分子是什么”“测了什么”“分子之间是什么关系”“依据在哪里”分开，就不容易填错位置。
sections.en: Separate molecular identity, measurements, relationships and supporting sources before entering data.

en: Object
Plain meaning
Where it belongs / example
Paper / Workspace
A paper / its review workspace
Keep records for the same paper together
Compound
An identified compound in the paper
Label 7a, 24 or an explicit author label
Structure
The chemical structure for that identity
Atoms, bonds, attachment positions and stereochemistry

One measurement for that molecule
An IC50, solubility or other assay result

An SAR series or a synthetic route

blocks.zh: 一个 Compound 可以有多条 Activity，也可以参与多个 Lineage。例如同一分子既是合成终产物，也用于 SAR 比较；仍只保留一个对应的 Compound，分别加入需要的组。
blocks.en: A Compound may have several Activities and participate in several Lineages. The same molecule can be a synthesis product and an SAR comparison member; reuse the Compound in both groups.

sections.title_zh: 03 · 文章信息：从这里开始审核，再清点分子
sections.title_en: 03 · Start with article information, then inventory compounds
sections.zh: 核对题名、DOI 和 PDF。收录所有有编号或标签且结构可确定的 Compound，包括无活性数据的原料、中间体和对照。示例仅演示格式，不应复制为论文事实。
sections.en: Verify title, DOI and PDF. Include every numbered or labelled Compound with a determinable structure, including starting materials, intermediates and controls without activity data. Examples illustrate format and are not paper facts.

blocks.zh: 打开任务后先看“文章信息”页签。这里包括书目信息与 Abstract、六个研究信息模块，以及文章级分子标注。先理解论文的研究范围，再进入 Compound 和 Lineage；详细字段标准见第 12–13 节。
blocks.en: Start with the Article information tab. It contains bibliography and Abstract, six research-information modules, and article-level compound annotations. Establish the study scope before reviewing Compounds and Lineages; detailed field guidance is in sections 12–13.

zh: 区域
怎么看、怎么修改
基础信息与 Abstract
先核对题名、期刊、年份、DOI、PMID / PMCID 和原文摘要。点击“编辑基础信息”修改，书目来源与摘要检查状态在“书目追溯信息”中；长摘要可展开全文。
六个研究信息模块
分子类型、作用方式、研究靶点与关联基因、优化目标、疾病与应用方向、PDB。桌面端左右两列，模块内独立滚动；进入“编辑基础信息”后展开对应模块修改。
依据与原文
展开“依据与说明／编号与依据”核对摘录、位置与提示；按“打开对应原文”或“查看原图区域”核实。没有原图按钮时仍可按来源链接和页码核对。
文章级分子标注
包括研究起点、枢纽分子和论文优选。先录入 Compound 和来源 Evidence，再点击“添加文章标注”，选择分子、类别、适用范围、依据和审核状态。
保存与区段确认
保存后核对实际显示。AI 预填、打开页面或保存修改都不等于文章信息区段已经核对完成；确认新增内容和疑点后，按区段审核控件明确确认。空白不自动表示未报告。
en: Area
How to read and edit
Bibliography and Abstract
Verify title, journal, year, DOI, PMID / PMCID and the original abstract. Use Edit bibliography; provenance and abstract check state are in bibliographic traceability details. Expand long abstracts.
Six research-information modules

Molecule types, mechanisms, targets and genes, optimization goals, disease context, and PDB. Desktop modules use two columns and independent scrolling. Use Edit bibliography and expand the relevant module to edit.
Evidence and sources
Expand evidence/identifier details to inspect quotations, locations and hints. Use the source-page or source-region controls; if no crop button is available, check the source link and page.
Article-level compound annotations
Study starts, hub compounds and paper-prioritized compounds. Create the Compound and source Evidence first, then Add article annotation and choose compound, role, scope, support and review status.
Saving and section confirmation

Check the saved display. AI prefill, opening the page or saving an edit does not establish section review. Check new content and uncertainties, then explicitly confirm through the section review controls. Blank does not automatically mean unreported.

zh: 核对题名、DOI、期刊和年份；打开 Source PDF，确认正文确实属于这篇文章。若打开错文献，先暂停该篇并报告。
记录 PDF 阅读器的实际页码（从 1 开始），不要把印刷页码 3456 填成 PDF 第 3456 页。正文写“Table 2”时同时记录它在 PDF 的哪一页。
逐处检查正文、图表、Scheme、实验方法与当前可获得的补充材料。建立清单：原文标签、出现位置、是否有可确定的结构、是否已录入、疑点。
按编号段检查覆盖，例如发现 24–31 和 55–73，要逐个对照清单。编号连续不证明结构相同；编号有缺口也不证明一定漏记，回原文确认。
原料、中间体、活性对照和比较分子，只要来源能识别其标签并确定结构，就在 Compound 范围内。没有 Activity 不是排除理由。
en: Match the title, DOI, journal and year, and confirm that Source PDF belongs to this paper. Stop work on a mismatched source and report it.
Use the PDF viewer’s physical page number, starting at 1. A printed journal page such as 3456 is not PDF page 3456. Record the physical page together with Table 2 or Scheme 1.

Inspect text, tables, figures, schemes, experimental methods and available supplementary material. Inventory each source label, location, determinable structure, presence in the workspace and uncertainty.
Audit label ranges individually, for example 24–31 and 55–73. Consecutive labels do not imply similar structures; a numbering gap is a reason to inspect the source, not proof of an omission.
Include identifiable, structurally defined starting materials, intermediates, controls and comparison compounds. Lack of Activity does not exclude a Compound.

blocks.zh: 仅知道编号、完全无法确定结构时，不要复制邻近分子的结构凑数。在核对记录/给负责人的问题清单中保留编号、页码与缺失原因。结构有完整来源支持但仍有某项不确定时，可保留候选并具体说明“需核对”；这与凭空造结构不同。缺少 SI 时记录范围限制，不写“全文已确认无遗漏”。
blocks.en: If only a label is known and no complete structure can be established, retain the label, source page and gap in your issue log for the supervisor; do not copy a neighboring structure. A complete source-supported candidate with a specific uncertainty may carry a verification hint. Record unavailable SI as a coverage limit rather than claiming exhaustive coverage.

sections.zh: Compound label 保留原文编号（例：24、7a）；显示名称可为空。每个 Compound 维护一个 Structure；SMILES/结构编辑器输入后核对连接、取代位置和立体化学。不能确定时说明原因并明确 unresolved，不虚构结构。
sections.en: Keep source labels such as 24 or 7a; display name is optional. Each Compound has one Structure. Verify connectivity, substitution and stereochemistry after entering SMILES or using the structure editor. Explain unresolved identity rather than inventing a structure.

zh: 字段
应该填什么
常见错误
Compound label
原文标签，保留 7a、(R)-24 等有意义的区别
用自己编的连续编号替代原标签
显示名称
作者别名或清晰的常用名称；没有可留空
把别名中的数字自动当成 Compound label
描述
分子的用途、来源、系列、未加入 Lineage 的理由
只写“无”，让下一位 reviewer 无法判断
需核对
具体疑点＋来源位置＋下一步要核对什么
只写“AI 可能有错”或未经解决就清空
en: Field
What to enter
Common mistake
Compound label
Keep source labels and meaningful distinctions such as 7a or (R)-24
Replacing source labels with your own sequence
Display name
An author alias or established name; leave blank if absent
Interpreting a number in an alias as the paper label
Description
Purpose, source, series and why no Lineage applies
Writing only “none” without an explanation
Verification hint
Specific uncertainty, source location and what must be checked
Vague “AI may be wrong” or clearing it before resolution

zh: 从“化合物与结构”左侧选择编号，确认右侧详情也是同一个分子。需要补录时点击“添加 Compound”，先检查清单中是否已有同一标签。
保存编号后完成结构与来源核对；要补充用途或疑点，使用该条目的“编辑”。先核对结构相同是否意味着同一身份，不要仅凭结构相同就合并作者明确区分的条目。
立体异构体、盐型、互变异构形式和重用编号容易混淆。以作者标注和明确结构为准；不懂该如何区分时保留说明，请负责人确认，不自行标准化。
en: Select a source label on the left and confirm the detail panel shows the same compound. Before Add Compound, check whether the label already exists.
After saving the label, complete structure and source checks. Use Edit for purpose and uncertainty notes. Identical-looking structures alone do not justify merging author-distinguished identities.
Stereoisomers, salts, tautomers and reused labels require care. Follow explicit author identity and structure; ask your supervisor before normalizing unfamiliar cases.

blocks.zh: 左侧是本篇 Compound 清单，右侧是所选分子的结构与来源、Activity。一次核对一个编号，避免看着上一条的图填写下一条。
blocks.en: The left panel lists this paper’s Compounds; the right panel contains the selected structure, sources and Activities. Check one label at a time to avoid mixing neighboring records.

blocks.zh: 复制当前 Compound 后，点击“粘贴为新条目”。编号和显示名称默认留空；填写新编号后保存。同编号不可保存，同显示名称只提示。副本包含结构、来源图片和 Activity；结构恢复为 Draft，不复制 Lineage 成员、文章标注或已查看状态。
blocks.en: Copy the current Compound, then paste as a new record. Identifier and display name start blank. A duplicate identifier blocks saving; a duplicate display name only warns. The copy includes structure, source images and Activities; its structure is Draft, with no copied Lineage membership, article highlights or viewed state.

sections.title_zh: 05 · 结构复核：画得像还不够
sections.title_en: 05 · Structure review: check the molecular graph
sections.zh: 不会手写 SMILES 也可以先学习逐项对照结构图；无法独立判断时不要点“已确认”。结构复核的重点是原子和键的连接关系。
sections.en: You can learn to compare drawings before learning to write SMILES. Do not mark a structure confirmed when you cannot assess it. Focus on which atoms and bonds are connected.

zh: 锁定来源：寻找该编号的结构图，或“共用骨架＋该编号的取代表”。R、R¹、R² 是变量，不是已确定的原子；必须逐个对应本分子的取代基。
看骨架：沿每个环走一圈数原子，区分五元/六元环；看清稠环共用一条边、螺环共用一个原子、桥环的连接方式。不要靠整体轮廓或名称相似判断。
看原子：C、N、O、S 是否在正确位置？芳环中一个 N 的位置改变就是另一个结构。未标出的顶点通常是碳，但必须结合规范的骨架式阅读。
看取代：从骨架连接点沿支链检查 Me/OMe、Ph/Bn、链长、邻间对位。Ph 直接接芳环；Bn 多一个 CH₂；OMe 比 Me 多一个 O。
看键和状态：单/双/芳香键、羰基位置、形式电荷、标明的氢、盐的组成，以及实楔/虚楔和 E/Z。不要替原文补出未指定的立体化学。
保存后检查重新生成的结构图。SMILES 字符串可能有多种等价写法；软件能解析只说明格式可读，不证明与原文一致。最后根据实际核对结果选择结构状态。
en: Locate the exact labeled drawing or shared scaffold plus the compound-specific substituent row. R, R¹ and R² are variables, not resolved atoms.

Trace each ring and count atoms; distinguish five- and six-membered rings. Fused rings share an edge, spiro rings one atom, and bridged systems have different connectivity. Overall shape or a similar name is insufficient.
Check atom identity and position: C, N, O and S. Moving one aromatic N changes the molecule. Unlabeled skeletal vertices usually represent carbon; read the drawing conventions carefully.
Follow each attachment from the scaffold: Me versus OMe, Ph versus Bn, chain length and ortho/meta/para position. Bn adds CH₂ relative to Ph; OMe adds O relative to Me.
Check single/double/aromatic bonds, carbonyl location, formal charges, explicit hydrogens, salt components, wedges/dashes and E/Z. Do not assign stereochemistry that the source leaves unspecified.

Inspect the regenerated drawing after saving. Different SMILES can describe the same structure; parser acceptance establishes readable syntax, not source correctness. Set the structure disposition only after review.

blocks.zh: 两种输入方式都直接保存同一个 Structure。使用 Ketcher 时，完成绘图后点击“保存 Ketcher Draft”；解析成功后，上方 SMILES 会自动显示生成结果，下方 RDKit 重绘会随保存后的结构更新，不需要手动复制或再保存一次 SMILES。若直接修改 SMILES，点击“保存 SMILES Draft”也会更新重绘。图对应已保存的结构，不随尚未保存的输入变化；无效结构草稿没有可用重绘，仍需修订。保存 Draft 不等于科学确认，复核来源后再点“确认 Structure”。
blocks.en: Both input methods save the same Structure. After drawing in Ketcher, choose Save Ketcher Draft. When parsing succeeds, the SMILES field automatically shows the generated result and the RDKit depiction updates to the saved structure; no manual copy or second SMILES save is needed. Editing SMILES and choosing Save SMILES Draft also updates the depiction. The image represents saved content, not unsaved typing; an invalid draft has no usable depiction and needs correction. Saving a draft is not scientific confirmation: check the source before Confirm Structure.

zh: 状态
含义 / 使用时机
draft
录入或 AI 预填后尚未完成复核
reviewer_confirmed
你已对照来源核实当前结构
unresolved
有来源歧义或当前无法解决的问题；写清原因
not_reported
来源未报告相应结构信息；先确认是真的未报告，不是找不到或不会画
en: Status
Meaning / when to use
draft
Entered or prefilled, not yet fully checked
reviewer_confirmed
You verified the current structure against its source
unresolved
Source ambiguity or a problem you cannot resolve; explain it
not_reported
The source does not report the structure information; do not use merely because you cannot find or draw it

blocks.zh: 新手最容易漏的是环大小、杂原子位置和连接点。若三个细节中有一项无法确定，记录具体问题并保留未决。截图只截到通式骨架时，还必须核对同一编号的 R 基取代表。
blocks.en: Ring size, heteroatom position and attachment points are frequent beginner errors. Keep a specific unresolved note if any cannot be checked. A generic scaffold crop also requires the matching substituent row.

blocks.zh: “标记无法解析”和“文章未报告结构”打开结构缺失说明，不立即清空结构。选择结构可用性，填写缺失原因、编号身份来源、已检查范围和缺失附件，先“保存缺失说明 Draft”，再“确认当前缺失说明”。保存缺失说明会清空当前 SMILES / Molfile；确认说明不等于确认分子图。原文未报告、来源未查完、结构无法判定必须区分，缺 SI 不能直接当未报告。编号、活性和 Table 行仍保留；后来补齐结构时更新同一个 Compound，并重新确认。旧条目不会自动补造来源说明。已有完整候选但局部存疑时，保留结构 Draft 并填写核对提示。
blocks.en: Mark unresolved and Structure not reported open an explanation form without immediately clearing chemistry. Choose availability and enter a reason, the identity source, checked sources and missing supplements. Save the explanation as Draft, then Confirm current absence explanation. Saving clears the current SMILES / Molfile; confirming the explanation does not confirm a molecular graph. Distinguish not reported, checking incomplete and unresolved; missing SI is not proof of absence. Labels, Activities and Table rows remain. Later structure completion updates the same Compound and needs confirmation again. Legacy entries do not gain invented provenance. Keep a supported complete candidate as Draft with a verification hint when only a specific detail is uncertain.

blocks.zh: 可输入 IUPAC 名称并使用本地 OPSIN 转换为结构；结果载入编辑器后仍需人工核对、保存 Draft 和确认。不能解析的名称会提示失败，不会替换已保存结构。
blocks.en: Enter an IUPAC name to convert locally with OPSIN. Check the result in the editor, save a Draft and confirm separately. Failed parsing does not replace the saved structure.

sections.title_zh: 06 · Activity：一条测定拆成哪些字段
sections.zh: 例（虚构）：Assay = human MAO-B inhibition；Metric = IC50；Operator = <；Value = 10；Unit = nM；Context 写明测定条件。不要把 <10 nM 全部塞进 Value，不混合不同 assay 的数值。保留原单位与限制条件。
sections.en: Fictional example: Assay = human MAO-B inhibition; Metric = IC50; Operator = <; Value = 10; Unit = nM; Context records assay conditions. Do not put <10 nM entirely in Value or combine different assays. Preserve units and qualifiers.

blocks.zh: “活性对比”按原文 Table 与 Other 整理数据。原文表保存表号、标题、页码及列组合；自定义表不代表原文表。Other 自动展示尚未分配的 Activity，包括正文、图和待核对归属的数据，不可删除。浏览不会创建或保存表格。Reviewer 可新建表格，或从 Other 创建自定义草稿，选择测定、列名和明确的记录；改列名不会改变数据归属。按条件原文或 Compound 编号筛选只改变预览，再明确勾选记录。保存时冻结所选 Activity ID，后续新增记录先进入 Other；数值、条件修订仍引用最新 Activity。列可拖动或用左右按钮排序，重复观测不合并。表格保存在文章工作区，可跨设备访问；保存需工作区版本一致，冲突时保留本地草稿。已有浏览器配置可明确导入为自定义表，原配置保留。AI 新增或修订的表格需 Reviewer 再次确认，人工修改配置并保存后也需确认；确认前先保存列配置；无法确定表格解释时可标记“无法判定”，并填写审核备注。提交检查中的表格问题可直接定位到对应表。点击编号进入 Compound，点击数值定位对应 Activity，返回保留当前表格、筛选和位置。Other 中的记录来源需要逐条核对，不能推断它们一定不在原文表中。Admin 和已提交工作区只读。浏览不产生 Viewed 或 Confirm；确认表格只确认表格解释，不替代各科学条目的确认。 在“调整 Compound 行”中选择已有 Compound、增减行或用上下箭头调整顺序。移除行仅解除本表对应 Activity 的归属，不删除科学记录；未被其他表引用的记录返回 Other。添加空行后，在列配置中勾选具体测定记录；选择列记录时会加入其 Compound 行。手动行列表与顺序随表保存；“表内行顺序”显示手动顺序。原文表需明确关联 Table Evidence 截图，支持已有证据多选、跨页多张、放大与原文页。先保存表格，再用“添加 / 重新框选 Table 截图”创建或修改证据；保存证据后从已有列表选择并保存关联。有效截图需与当前 PDF 一致且包含有效页码和选区。无截图可保存草稿或标记无法判定，但不能确认原文表。共享 Evidence 的修改影响全部引用，并使相关表格重新待确认。Other 和自定义表无需整表截图。
blocks.en: Activity comparison organizes records into original paper Tables and Other. Original tables retain their label, title, page and column arrangement; custom tables do not imply an original source table. Other automatically contains unassigned Activities from text, figures or records whose table membership still needs verification, and cannot be deleted. Browsing never creates or saves tables. Reviewers can create a table or start a custom draft from Other, selecting measurements, display titles and explicit records. Renaming never changes membership. Literal condition or Compound search only filters the preview; select records explicitly. Saving freezes selected Activity IDs; new records initially appear in Other, while values and conditions reference current Activities. Reorder columns by dragging or arrow buttons; repeated observations remain separate. Tables are saved with the workspace across devices using version checks; conflicts preserve local drafts. Existing browser configurations can be explicitly imported as custom tables while retaining the original browser copy. AI-created or revised tables require Reviewer confirmation again, as do actual saved manual configuration changes. Save configuration before confirming. If the interpretation cannot be determined, mark the table Unresolved and add review notes. Submission blockers navigate to the exact table. Click a Compound or value to navigate to its exact Activity, then return to the table, filters and scroll position. Other membership does not prove that a record is outside all original tables; verify its source. Admin and submitted workspaces are read-only. Browsing does not mark Viewed or Confirm; confirming table interpretation does not confirm individual scientific records. Use Adjust Compound rows to select existing Compounds, add or remove rows, and reorder using arrows. Removing a row only unassigns its Activities from this table; scientific records are retained and records unused by other tables return to Other. After adding an empty row, select its exact measurements in column configuration; selecting column records also includes their Compound rows. Explicit row membership and order are saved; Table row order displays the manual order. Original tables require explicitly linked Table Evidence screenshots. Select existing evidence, including multiple pages, zoom the crop or open its original page. Save the table before creating or reframing screenshots; after saving Evidence, select it from the existing library and save the association. Valid screenshots match the current PDF and have a valid page and region. Missing screenshots permit a draft or Unresolved disposition, but cannot confirm an original table. Editing shared Evidence affects every reference and resets linked table confirmations. Other and custom tables do not require whole-table screenshots.

blocks.zh: IC50 通常指达到 50% 抑制时的浓度；在同一实验体系中数值较小通常表示更强抑制。EC50、Ki、Kd、细胞存活率、溶解度和暴露量回答不同问题，不能混在一起排名。不同靶点、物种、细胞系、时间或测定条件的 IC50 也不能直接当成一次优化前后。
blocks.en: IC50 usually denotes the concentration producing 50% inhibition; lower values generally indicate stronger inhibition within the same assay. EC50, Ki, Kd, viability, solubility and exposure answer different questions. Even IC50 values from different targets, species, cell lines, times or conditions are not automatically comparable.

zh: 确认正在编辑的是对应 Compound，再点击“添加 Activity”。同一分子在不同 assay 下的数据分别保存，不用覆盖原有那一条。
横向检查行标签、列标题、单位和脚注。看到 12 ± 3 nM，Value 填 12，误差“±3”及其 SD/SEM 定义保留到 Context；不要自行猜误差类型。
ND、NT、inactive 等文字不是数值 0。保留原文含义和条件，在说明/证据中记录；当前数值表单无法准确表达时请负责人确定处理方式，不编造数字。
保存后点开证据检查截图，确认确实是本编号、本指标、正确单位的那一格。
en: Confirm the selected Compound before Add Activity. Save separate records for separate assays rather than overwriting a different measurement.
Read the row label, column heading, units and footnotes together. For 12 ± 3 nM, enter 12 as Value and preserve ±3 and its stated SD/SEM meaning in Context; never guess the error type.
ND, NT and inactive are not numeric zero. Preserve their reported meaning and conditions in notes/evidence; ask your supervisor if the numeric form cannot represent them faithfully.
After saving, open the evidence and verify the crop contains the right compound, endpoint and units.

blocks.zh: 虚构的 <10 nM 示例：运算符、数值和单位分别填写，Context 记录实验条件；Evidence 指向来源。
blocks.en: Fictional <10 nM example: enter operator, number and unit separately, retain conditions in Context and link source Evidence.

sections.title_zh: 07 · Evidence 与截图：让别人能复核
sections.title_en: 07 · Evidence and crops: make records traceable
sections.zh: 关系类型、起终点、修改摘要都要核对。例（虚构格式）：Me → OMe，比较亲脂性变化；该关系由结构比较推断，未见作者明确说明。区分原文支持与推断，不把表格并列当优化顺序。Evidence 保留逐字引文、PDF 实际页码和区域；supports/contradicts/contextual 表示证据作用。阅读不自动把 draft 改为 reviewer_confirmed。
sections.en: Verify relationship type, endpoints and modification summary. Fictional format example: Me → OMe, comparing lipophilicity; relationship inferred from structures, not explicitly stated by the authors. Distinguish source support from inference; table order is not optimization order. Evidence retains exact quotations, actual PDF page and region. supports/contradicts/contextual describe evidence roles. Viewing never changes draft to reviewer_confirmed.

blocks.zh: Evidence 是可复核的出处。quoted text 放逐字原文；Caption 用来标明 Table/Figure/Scheme；Reviewer note 放你的解释、翻译或推断。不要把你的推断写成带引号的作者结论。
blocks.en: Evidence provides a checkable source. Use quoted text for verbatim wording, Caption for Table/Figure/Scheme identification, and Reviewer note for interpretation, translation or inference. Do not present your interpretation as an author quotation.

zh: 从当前 Activity 的证据入口或 Lineage 的“添加 / 编辑关系证据”打开 Evidence；可复用已有证据，不必为同一原文反复新建。
确认 PDF 页码和页面方向，再框选区域。Activity 表格尽量包含化合物行标签、列标题、单位及关键脚注；区域过大看不清，过小无法判断。
保存后检查实际生成的截图，别只看框选动作是否成功。逐一核对编号、指标、数值、单位、脚注有没有截错行/列。
若截图为空、偏移或截到了相邻结果，重新核对页码和区域后修正来源记录；有“重试”时可重试生成，但错误坐标不会因为重试自动变正确。
Edge 证据选择 supports / contradicts / contextual，分别表示支持、反驳、提供背景。同一段文字可能只支持某一条关系，不要不加区分地关联整张图的所有边。
en: Open Evidence from the Activity area or Add / edit relationship evidence in a Lineage. Reuse existing evidence where appropriate.

Check the PDF page and orientation before selecting a region. For an Activity table, include the compound row label, endpoint heading, unit and relevant footnote. Avoid illegibly broad or context-free tiny crops.
Inspect the generated image after saving, not just the selection rectangle. Verify label, endpoint, value, unit and footnote against the intended row and column.
For blank, shifted or neighboring-result crops, correct the source page/region. Retry generation when offered, but retrying cannot repair incorrect coordinates.
For Edge evidence, supports, contradicts and contextual mean support, contradiction and background. A passage may support only one relationship; do not automatically attach it to every edge.

blocks.zh: 暂时没有生成图片不等于原文没有数据；有一张图片也不等于数据已经核对正确。跨页表格可能需要结合多个来源位置阅读，Reviewer note 应写明需要一起看的位置。
blocks.en: A missing generated crop does not mean missing source data; an existing image does not prove correctness. A table spanning pages may require several source locations, which should be identified in the reviewer note.

sections.title_zh: 08 · Lineage：每张图按什么逻辑构建
sections.title_en: 08 · Lineage: how to construct each graph
sections.zh: 每张 SAR Lineage 图应围绕“共同起点或基准＋一个明确的优化主题＋有依据的分子关系”构建。先确定本图回答什么优化问题，再选择节点和边。同一基准下的一组探索优先放在一起；枢纽分子成为新基准并展开新一组优化时，优先在它处分图。synthesis 则按实际前体到产物的路线单独构建，不能混入 SAR 设计关系。
sections.en: Build each SAR Lineage around a common starting point or baseline, a clear optimization theme, and supported relationships. Define the question the graph answers before choosing nodes and edges. Keep exploration around the same baseline together; prefer splitting at a hub compound when it becomes the baseline for a new optimization group. Build synthesis Lineages separately from actual precursor-to-product routes, without mixing in SAR design relationships.

zh: 先分清图的类别。SAR 图表达设计演进或结构比较；synthesis 图表达实际合成转化。相同 Compound 可出现在两类图中，但不能把两种边混成一条优化线路。
先写一句本图要回答的问题：“以哪个分子／哪些有依据的共同基准为起点，围绕哪个位点、骨架或性质问题，比较哪一组分子？”例如“以 3 为基准的侧链优化，探索代谢稳定性”。名称和描述应能说明这件事。
按这个问题选成员。纳入同一组探索中有依据的分子，包括没有改善或未被优选的分子。不要把整篇文章、整张 Table 或所有结构相似的分子自动装进一张图；缺乏关系依据的分子仍保留在 Compound 清单。
逐条确定直接关系。若 2、3、4 都以 1 为基准，就画 1→2、1→3、1→4；若 5、6 是从 3 开展的新一轮设计，就从 3 连出。每条边核对端点、方向、关系含义和 Evidence；不凭编号、活性高低或结构相似性推断优化先后。
再判断是否分图。同一基准、同一主题的一组探索优先合并；独立主题形成各自完整的分支时可拆；选出枢纽分子并开展新一组优化时优先在该处分开。短链通常合并，依赖大量交叉比较或汇合的分支也优先保留在一起。具体情形见下表。
最后检查衔接与完整性。拆图时复用同一个 Compound，说明前后 Lineage 与枢纽分子的衔接，逐条核对没有漏 Member、Edge 或 Evidence；不能为连通或填满图而编造、重复关系。确认科学关系后再整理点线布局。
en: Choose the graph category first. SAR graphs express design evolution or structural comparison; synthesis graphs express actual chemical transformations. The same Compound may occur in both categories, but do not mix the two kinds of edges into one optimization route.

Write the graph’s question first: which compound or supported common baselines start the group, which site/scaffold/property problem is explored, and which compounds are compared? For example, “Side-chain optimization from 3 to explore metabolic stability.” The name and description should explain this scope.

Select members for that question. Include supported members of the exploration group, including unsuccessful and non-prioritized compounds. Do not automatically place an entire paper, table or set of similar structures in one graph. Keep compounds without supported relationships in the Compound catalog.

Establish direct relationships individually. If 2, 3 and 4 all use 1 as baseline, draw 1→2, 1→3 and 1→4. If 5 and 6 are designed from 3, connect them from 3. Check each edge’s endpoints, direction, meaning and Evidence; labels, potency rankings and structural resemblance do not establish optimization chronology.

Then decide whether to split. Prefer one graph for exploration around the same baseline and theme. Independent themes forming complete branches may be split; prefer splitting at a hub compound when it starts a new optimization group. Keep short chains together, and usually retain branches with extensive cross-comparisons or convergence in one graph. See the decision table below.

Finally audit continuity and completeness. Reuse the same Compound across graphs, describe the adjoining Lineages and hub compound, and check for missing members, edges or evidence. Do not invent or duplicate relationships to connect or populate graphs. Arrange the compact graph only after establishing the science.

blocks.zh:
每张 SAR 图的描述模板（按原文填写）
共同起点／基准：Compound …
本图优化主题：…

连边依据：作者明确的设计关系／有范围限定的 SAR 比较；对应 Evidence …
与其他图的衔接：Compound … 为枢纽分子，承接／引出 Lineage …；没有衔接则说明不适用。

若无法写清共同基准或主题，先重新检查分组；若关系证据不足，保留疑点，不靠布局制造完整路线。
blocks.en:
Description template for each SAR graph (complete from the source)
Shared start / baseline: Compound …
Optimization theme: …
Member scope: … (series, site or relevant tables/figures)
Edge support: explicit author design relationships / scoped SAR comparisons; Evidence …
Connections: Compound … is the hub linking from/to Lineage …; state not applicable if no connection exists.

If the baseline or theme cannot be explained, revisit grouping. If relationship support is missing, retain uncertainty rather than using layout to manufacture a complete route.

blocks.zh: 拆分的核心是“是否出现新的优化基准和新一组探索”，不是每次换 Table、换优化目标或出现分叉就拆图。一个 root 可以对应多个优化分支；一个图也可以有多个有依据的 root。
blocks.en: The key split criterion is a new optimization baseline followed by a new group of exploration, not every new table, objective or branch. One root may support several branches, and a graph may have several source-supported roots.

Graph A: 1 (root) → 2, 3, 4 (local terminals)
Graph B: 3 (root) → 5, 6, 7 (local terminals)
3 is the hub compound; both graphs use the same Compound.
If the authors prioritize 6, add its paper-prioritized article annotation; do not infer it from terminal position.

blocks.zh: 拆分前后逐条核对 Member、Edge 和 Evidence：示例中的 1→3 留在 A，3→5/6/7 放在 B，不漏边，也不为填满两图重复建立同一科学关系。两图描述注明衔接分子及前后 Lineage 名称；新增 Node 时选择已有 Compound，不复制结构、Activity 或化合物身份。若拆分使真实的跨组关系无法清楚保留，合并相关组。未成功或未被优选的分支仍要保留；没有关系依据的分子仍可留在 Compound 清单。
blocks.en: Audit members, edges and evidence before and after splitting: keep 1→3 in A and 3→5/6/7 in B. Do not omit edges or duplicate a scientific relationship just to populate both graphs. Name the shared compound and adjoining Lineages in their descriptions. Add existing Compounds as nodes rather than copying identities, structures or Activities. Merge groups if splitting prevents clear retention of real cross-group relationships. Preserve unsuccessful and non-prioritized branches; compounds without supported relationships may remain in the Compound catalog.

7a（Me） → 7c（F）
已说明共同参考物；箭头表示有依据的比较，不表示 7b 合成出 7c。

7a (Me) → 7b (OMe)
7a (Me) → 7c (F)
A stated common reference; arrows represent supported comparisons, not synthesis of 7c from 7b.

blocks.en: A branching example Lineage. Check its category and grouping rationale, then members and the support for each edge. Node position is presentation only.

blocks.zh: 以下五组案例全部虚构，截图来自真实 Reviewer 点线图界面。编号只是教学标签，假设作者已明确说明下述设计／比较关系；不能在真实论文中仅按这些编号或图形套用关系。截图中的“已确认”也只是教学状态。点击截图可放大查看。
blocks.en: The five cases below are entirely fictional and captured from the real Reviewer point-and-arrow interface. Numbers are teaching labels; assume explicit author support for the stated design/comparison relationships. Never infer real-paper relationships from these numbers or graph shapes. Confirmed annotations are also fictional teaching states. Open screenshots for full-size viewing.

blocks.zh: 案例 1：同一基准、同一主题，合并成一张图。假设作者以 1 为参考，平行比较侧链不同的 2、3、4；其中 4 未改善，也要保留。这是一组共同基准下的探索，画 1→2、1→3、1→4，不按编号串成 1→2→3→4。
blocks.en: Case 1: one baseline and one theme belong together. Suppose the authors compare side-chain analogues 2, 3 and 4 against 1 in parallel. Retain 4 even if it did not improve. Draw 1→2, 1→3 and 1→4, not a sequence 1→2→3→4.

blocks.zh: 案例 1 · 同一基准的一批优化：一个 root 对应并列分支，保留未成功分子。
blocks.en: Case 1 · One optimization batch from a common baseline: parallel branches from one root, including unsuccessful compounds.

blocks.zh: 案例 2：选出枢纽分子，再开展新一批优化，优先拆成前后两图。假设首轮为 1→2/3/4，作者选出 3，随后以它为基准设计 5、6、7。前图 A 中 3 是 terminal；后图 B 中同一个 3 是 root，并显示“枢纽分子”。若作者优选 6，则单独标为“论文优选”。两图复用同一个 Compound 3，不复制分子记录；1→3 留在 A，3→5/6/7 留在 B。
blocks.en: Case 2: a selected hub starts a new optimization batch, so prefer successive graphs. Suppose the first batch is 1→2/3/4; the authors select 3 and design 5, 6 and 7 from it. In A, 3 is terminal; in B, the same 3 is root and carries the Hub compound annotation. If 6 is prioritized, mark that separately. Reuse Compound 3; keep 1→3 in A and 3→5/6/7 in B.

blocks.zh: 案例 2A · 前图：3 为本图末端，同时是衔接下一批探索的枢纽分子。
blocks.en: Case 2A · Earlier graph: 3 is a local terminal and the hub leading into the next exploration group.

blocks.zh: 案例 2B · 后图：复用同一个 3 作为 root；6 的论文优选标注独立判断。
blocks.en: Case 2B · Later graph: reuse 3 as root; assess the paper-prioritized annotation for 6 independently.

blocks.zh: 案例 3：同一个 root 下的两个独立优化主题，可以按分支拆图。假设 10→11/12 是侧链探索，10→21/22 是另一组环系替换；各自有明确设计叙述，而且没有必须一起阅读的交叉比较，可分别建图并复用 10。这不是因为分子编号不同或来自不同 Table，而是因为各分支形成了独立的优化问题。10 也不会仅因有多个分支就自动成为枢纽分子。
blocks.en: Case 3: independent optimization themes from the same root may be separated. Suppose 10→11/12 explores side chains, while 10→21/22 explores ring replacement. Each has an explicit design rationale and no cross-comparison requiring joint reading. Reuse 10 in separate graphs. Different labels or tables do not justify the split; independent optimization questions do. Multiple branches alone do not make 10 a hub compound.

blocks.zh: 案例 3A · 侧链优化：共同基准为 10，成员范围为 11、12。
blocks.en: Case 3A · Side-chain optimization: baseline 10 with members 11 and 12.

blocks.zh: 案例 3B · 环系优化：仍使用同一个 10，独立成员为 21、22。
blocks.en: Case 3B · Ring-system optimization: the same baseline 10 with independent members 21 and 22.

blocks.zh: 案例 4：同一问题下的连续短链，通常不拆图。假设作者先从 30 设计 31，再从 31 设计 32，两步都围绕同一侧链问题，并没有形成另一批独立探索。保留 30→31→32；31 的图内角色是 intermediate，不能仅因它有后续出边就标为枢纽分子。如果原文明确赋予它枢纽作用，标注与是否分图仍分别判断。
blocks.en: Case 4: keep a short continuous progression around one question together. Suppose 30 leads to 31 and then 32, both steps addressing the same side-chain problem with no independent new exploration batch. Keep 30→31→32. The local role of 31 is intermediate; an outgoing edge alone does not justify a hub annotation. If the source explicitly supports hub significance, assess that separately from whether to split.

blocks.zh: 案例 4 · 两步连续设计仍是一张图；不要求每个中间节点都成为新图 root。
blocks.en: Case 4 · Two design steps remain one graph; not every intermediate must start a new graph.

blocks.zh: 案例 5：分支存在重要交叉比较或汇合，优先保留在一张图。假设 40 分别引出 41、42，作者随后明确把 43 分别与 41、42 进行 SAR 比较，每条关系都有依据。保留 41→43 和 42→43，让两条路径都能看见。这里的两条入边不是说 41 与 42 一起合成了 43；若那是实际合成反应，应在 synthesis 中另行表达。不能为了画成树而删掉一条关系，也不能仅因 43 看起来像两者就补上两条边。
blocks.en: Case 5: retain important cross-comparisons or convergence in one graph. Suppose 40 leads separately to 41 and 42, and the authors explicitly compare 43 against both in SAR, with support for each relationship. Keep 41→43 and 42→43 visible. The incoming edges do not claim that 41 and 42 jointly synthesize 43; an actual reaction belongs in synthesis. Do not delete a relationship to force a tree, or invent two edges merely because 43 resembles both.

blocks.zh: 案例 5 · 两条有独立依据的关系汇入 43：保留汇合，不强制画成树。
blocks.en: Case 5 · Two independently supported relationships reach 43: retain convergence rather than forcing a tree.

blocks.zh: 搜索 Compound 编号或名称，可找到其所属 Lineage 并定位节点。复制 Lineage 后填写新的名称：副本复用 Compound 和 Evidence，建立独立的成员与 Edge，Edge 恢复为 Draft。同名 Lineage 会提示。
blocks.en: Search a Compound identifier or name to find its Lineage and focus the node. Paste a copied Lineage with a new name: it reuses Compounds and Evidence but creates independent members and Edges with Draft review status. Duplicate Lineage names show a warning.

sections.zh: root / intermediate / terminal 只描述当前图内的位置：root 包括初始起点，也包括本图从上一轮承接的枢纽分子；terminal 只是本图末端。“枢纽分子”描述分子的设计用途，“文章优选分子”对应文章信息中的“论文优选”。位置、用途和作者选择分别核对，可同时成立。
sections.en: Root / intermediate / terminal describe local graph position. A root may be an original start or a hub compound inherited from an earlier group; terminal means only the end of this graph. Hub-compound significance describes design use, while paper-prioritized compounds use the existing article annotation. Check position, use and author choice separately; they can coexist.

zh: 名称
如何判断
不代表什么
root
当前图的局部起点或比较基准；可为初始起点，也可为上一轮选出的枢纽分子；允许多个 root
不自动等于整篇研究起点
intermediate
当前组中间的节点，通常同时接收和引出关系
SAR 中不自动表示合成中间体
terminal
当前图的末端，图内没有后续出边；可在下一图继续优化
不自动等于最好活性、最终药物或论文优选
unspecified
尚不能确定该组内角色，需继续核对
不是为了省事永久不标
研究起点
作者据以启动本文/该系列优化的分子，有来源理由
不是每个便宜试剂或每条路线的第一个原料
论文优选
作者明确选择优先推进的分子，有选择依据
不是所有 terminal，也不是你自己挑最低 IC50
枢纽分子
原文支持以该分子为基准继续开展下一组优化；可兼有 root / intermediate / terminal 角色
不是每个有出边的节点，也不自动等于文章优选
en: Name
How to decide
Does not mean
root
A local starting point or comparison baseline, either an original start or a subsequent start selected earlier; multiple roots are allowed
Automatically a study starting point
intermediate
An internal node, typically with incoming and outgoing relationships
Automatically a synthetic intermediate in an SAR group
terminal
A local endpoint with no outgoing edge in this graph; optimization may continue in the next graph
Best potency, final medicine or author-prioritized compound
unspecified
Role not yet determined; further review needed
A permanent shortcut around review
Study starting point
An author-supported starting molecule for this study/series
Every reagent or first material in a synthesis
Paper-prioritized compound
A molecule the authors explicitly choose to advance, with rationale
Every terminal or the reviewer’s lowest-IC50 choice
Hub compound
Source-supported baseline for a further optimization group; compatible with root / intermediate / terminal position
Not every node with an outgoing edge, and not automatically paper-prioritized

blocks.zh: “枢纽分子”指作者在研究过程中选定为后续一组优化基准、起承接作用的分子。这里的“枢纽”是设计过程中的作用，不按节点连线数量判断；不要求有多个分支，也不意味着活性最好或作者最终优选。
blocks.en: A hub compound is a molecule the authors select during the study as the baseline for a further optimization group. “Hub” describes its role in the design process, not its number of graph connections. It need not have multiple branches, the best potency or final prioritized status.

blocks.zh: 同一个 Compound 在不同 Lineage 可以有不同角色。一个研究可以有多个起点和多个优选；同一分子也可能兼任。判断关键是“作者在什么范围、为什么这样选”，不是分子排在第几行。
blocks.en: The same Compound can have different roles in different Lineages. A study can have several starts and priorities, and one molecule may carry both annotations. The key is the authors’ scope and rationale, not row order.

blocks.zh: 网站已支持独立的“枢纽分子”文章标注。在“文章信息 → 添加文章标注”中选择该类别，关联同一个 Compound、填写后续优化的系列／Lineage 范围和作者选择理由，并选择来源 Evidence。标注会随该分子显示在 Compound 与 Lineage 图中；它不会自动拆图或修改 root / intermediate / terminal。跨图复用时，在 Lineage 描述补充前后衔接；同一分子可兼有“研究起点”“枢纽分子”“论文优选”，但每项都应有明确依据。
blocks.en: The website supports a separate Hub compound article annotation. Under Article information → Add article annotation, select this role, link the existing Compound, specify the subsequent series/Lineage scope and author rationale, and choose source Evidence. The annotation appears with the compound in Compound views and Lineage graphs; it does not automatically split graphs or change root / intermediate / terminal. Describe links between successive groups in their Lineage descriptions. One compound may carry study-start, hub-compound and paper-prioritized annotations, each with explicit support.

sections.title_zh: 10 · 在画布和表单中编辑 Lineage
sections.title_en: 10 · Editing a Lineage in graph and forms
sections.zh: 三个页签切换。图上“新增 Node”选择本篇已有 Compound；找不到时先到化合物页创建。“新增 Edge”依次选择起点和终点，再填写关系表单。拖动节点或菱形控制点调整形状，点击“保存布局”；点线图与结构图独立保存。重新载入布局会丢弃该模式未保存的布局。表单仍是完整编辑入口。
sections.en: Switch between three tabs. Add Node selects an existing Compound from this paper; create missing Compounds on the compound page first. Add Edge selects source then target before opening the relationship form. Drag nodes or diamond control handles and Save layout. Point and structure modes save separately. Reload layout discards unsaved layout in that mode. Full forms remain available.

zh: 选择正确的 SAR / synthesis 类别和 Lineage，再切换“关系图／Compound／Edge”页签；一个页签占主要操作区域。
画布点击“新增 Node”，搜索并选择本篇已有 Compound，再选组内角色并确认。找不到编号时先检查它是否已在该组中；若本篇清单没有，再回化合物页补录。
点击“新增 Edge”，按提示先选来源分子、再选目标分子；进入 Edge 表单后再次检查两个编号、方向、关系类型、修改摘要及证据。保存前取消不会建立关系。
也可以在 Compound 页签添加 Member，在 Edge 页签使用完整表单。两种入口编辑同一组记录。
拖动节点调整位置，打开边曲线调整后拖动菱形控制点；点击“保存布局”。点线图与结构图的布局分开保存。
“重新载入布局”会放弃当前模式未保存的位置；“重排为网格”是重新布局。移动节点或弯曲连线不会改变 Edge 端点或科学审核状态。
en: Select the correct SAR / synthesis category and Lineage, then switch Graph / Compound / Edge; each tab uses the main work area.

Choose Add Node on the canvas, find an existing Compound and select its local role. If the label is absent, first check whether it is already a member; create a genuinely missing Compound on the compound page.

Choose Add Edge, then source and target as prompted. In the Edge form recheck both labels, direction, relation type, modification summary and evidence. Cancel before saving to avoid creating a relation.
Alternatively add a Member in the Compound tab and use full forms in the Edge tab. Both interfaces edit the same records.
Drag nodes; enable edge bending to drag diamond control handles. Choose Save layout. Point and structure modes keep separate layouts.
Reload layout discards unsaved positions in the current mode; grid rearrangement changes presentation. Moving nodes or bending edges does not change endpoints or scientific review status.

blocks.zh: 查看整体线路时可先用简短点线图：尽量让起点在左、后续优化向右，同批并列分子上下排列，具体结构再到 Compound 中查看。布局不是关系依据；1 同时比较 2、3、4 时画分叉，不画成 1→2→3→4。若实际直接基准是 3，后续分子就从 3 连出，不一律连回最初的 1。有依据的汇合或多个父节点可以保留，不必强行画成树。
blocks.en: For an overview, start with compact nodes and arrows: place starts on the left, subsequent optimization to the right and parallel analogues vertically. Inspect structures in Compound details. Layout does not establish relationships: comparisons of 1 against 2, 3 and 4 form a branch, not 1→2→3→4. If 3 is the direct baseline, connect its derivatives from 3 rather than from the original 1. Retain supported convergence and multiple parents instead of forcing a tree.

blocks.zh: “新增 Node”选择的是本篇已有 Compound；角色属于当前 Lineage。先核实编号，再确认添加。
blocks.en: Add Node selects an existing Compound from this paper. Its role belongs to the current Lineage; verify the label before confirming.

sections.title_zh: 11 · Edge：写清“变了什么”和“凭什么连”
sections.title_en: 11 · Edge: what changed and what supports the link
sections.zh: 每条边都应有可解释的端点、方向和关系。描述应区分结构差异、测定结果、作者解释与 reviewer 推断。
sections.en: Each edge needs interpretable endpoints, direction and meaning. Separate structural differences, measured results, author explanations and reviewer inference.

zh: 检查项
推荐写法 / 做法
端点与方向
先读 Parent / Child 的编号，再对照来源。合成通常前体→产物；SAR 方向按明确的参考/设计关系解释，不等于历史时间线。
关系类型
依实际关系填写；例如 SAR 比较与合成转化不混用。类型字段不替代完整说明。
修改摘要
虚构：相同骨架上对位 Me 替换为 OMe；同一 assay 的 IC50 由 120 nM 变为 40 nM。
结论边界
可以说该 assay 抑制更强；未测 logP 就不能把“亲脂性降低”写成已测事实。
推断标识
虚构：按结构比较建立，未见作者明确说明优化先后；方向以 7a 为参考物，不主张合成关系。
审核
读完来源后明确选 draft / reviewer_confirmed / unresolved；有冲突保留说明。
en: Check
Recommended approach
Endpoints and direction
Read Parent / Child labels first. Synthesis normally goes precursor→product. Explain SAR direction using a supported reference/design relationship, not assumed chronology.
Relation type
Use the actual relationship; distinguish SAR comparison from synthesis. The type does not replace a full explanation.
Modification summary
Fictional: para Me replaced by OMe on the same scaffold; IC50 changes from 120 to 40 nM in the same assay.
Claim boundary
Stronger inhibition in that assay is supported; an unmeasured logP change is not a measured fact.
Inference labeling
Fictional: comparison inferred from structures; author optimization order not stated. 7a is the reference, with no synthesis claim.
Disposition
After checking sources explicitly choose draft / reviewer_confirmed / unresolved and retain conflicts.

blocks.zh: 图上文字保持简短，优先说明该条边的具体结构变化，例如“侧链替换”“缩环”。在关系详情中分别写清结构改动、优化目标与实际观察结果，并核对本条边的端点和证据；不要把一条边的解释套用到整组。仅同表出现、结构相似或活性排序，不能证明真实的优化先后。
blocks.en: Keep graph labels short and specific to the edge, such as “side-chain replacement” or “ring contraction.” In relationship details, distinguish the structural change, optimization goal and observed result, and verify this edge’s endpoints and evidence. Do not apply one edge’s explanation to the whole group. Shared table membership, structural similarity or potency ranking do not establish optimization chronology.

blocks.zh: Edge 页签用于逐条核对端点、关系和审核状态。证据说明为何可以建立这条边，不能只凭图画得顺眼。
blocks.en: Use the Edge tab to check endpoints, meaning and disposition one relationship at a time. Sources justify the edge; a tidy graph does not.

sections.title_zh: 12 · 给研究起点／枢纽分子／论文优选添加依据
sections.title_en: 12 · Support study starts, hub compounds and prioritized compounds
sections.zh: 在文章信息页关联本篇 Compound 与已有 Evidence，记录研究起点、枢纽分子或论文优选、适用系列/范围及作者选择理由。每类可有多个分子，同一分子可兼任。先在 Evidence 库保存原文依据；标注卡片保留 PDF 页码与原文。研究起点不等于每条合成路线的原料；论文优选不等于所有 terminal 或最低 IC50。待审核、已确认、待解决分别显示，阅读不会自动确认；未记录不代表文章没有此类分子。修改理由、身份或来源后重新核对，需核对提示要显式清除。
sections.en: On the article information page, link a Compound and existing Evidence, record its study-start, hub-compound or paper-prioritized role, study/series scope and author rationale. Multiple compounds and coexisting annotations are allowed. Save source support in the Evidence library first; cards retain the PDF page and quotation. A study start is not every synthesis reagent; a prioritized compound is not every terminal or the lowest IC50. Draft, confirmed and unresolved states remain visible. Viewing never confirms; unrecorded does not mean absent. Recheck after changing identity, rationale or source, and explicitly clear resolved verification hints.

zh: 阅读 Introduction、Results/Discussion 和结论，找作者明确的起点或优先推进表述；结合 Figure/Table 核对化合物编号和别名。
先在 Evidence 中保存相关原文与 PDF 页码，再到“文章信息”点击“添加文章标注”。
选择本篇 Compound、标注类别、适用范围（例如全文或 Series A）、作者选择理由和来源 Evidence。理由可以包括活性、选择性、PK、脑暴露或体内效果，但只能写来源支持的部分。
确实核实后设为已确认；存在身份/依据冲突就设为待解决并解释。修改身份、理由或来源后重新核对，不能沿用旧的确认判断。
en: Read the Introduction, Results/Discussion and conclusion for explicit starting-point or advancement statements; verify labels and aliases against figures/tables.
Save the quotation and physical PDF page in Evidence, then choose Add article annotation on Article information.

Select the Compound, role, scope (whole study or Series A), author rationale and source Evidence. Potency, selectivity, PK, brain exposure or in vivo effects belong in the rationale only when supported.

Confirm only after verification. Use unresolved with an explanation for identity/support conflicts. Recheck after changing identity, rationale or evidence rather than carrying forward the old judgment.

blocks.zh: “枢纽分子”用于原文明确选出一个分子、以它为基准开展下一组优化的情况。适用范围写明后续系列或 Lineage 名称；理由解释为何选它、后续探索什么；Evidence 支持这个选择和承接关系。不要仅因有出边就添加标签。保存为待审核后，需要人工核实并设为已确认，或保留待解决及具体问题。相同分子同类别同范围不重复建立；新的范围可单独记录。
blocks.en: Use Hub compound when the source explicitly selects a compound as the baseline for another optimization group. Name the subsequent series or Lineage in Scope, explain the choice and exploration in Rationale, and link Evidence supporting that transition. An outgoing edge alone is insufficient. Draft annotations require explicit human confirmation or an unresolved disposition with a specific issue. Do not duplicate the same compound, role and scope; a distinct scope may have its own annotation.

blocks.zh: 某分子在体外最强，但作者因暴露量差而放弃，不能标为论文优选。某化合物只作为外部药物对照，也不能因为出现在 Figure 1 就标为研究起点。
blocks.en: The most potent in vitro compound may have been abandoned for poor exposure. An external drug comparator appearing in Figure 1 is not automatically a study starting point.

sections.title_zh: 13 · 文章信息：摘要、分子类型、靶点与证据
sections.title_en: 13 · Article information: abstract, molecule types, targets and evidence
sections.zh: 文章信息需同时核对书目身份、原文摘要、分子类型、作用方式、研究靶点与关联基因、优化目标、疾病方向和 PDB。AI 补填仍是待核对内容。模块可独立滚动，依据与原图默认折叠；请展开并检查完整内容。空白表示未记录，不表示原文未报告。
sections.en: Check bibliographic identity, source abstract, molecule types, mechanisms, targets and genes, optimization goals, disease context and PDB references. AI supplements still require review. Modules scroll independently and evidence/crops start collapsed; expand them to check all content. Empty means unrecorded, not unreported by the paper.

zh: 模块
核对要点
PMID / PMCID
PMID 是 PubMed 数字编号，PMCID 带 PMC 前缀；打开链接核对题名、DOI 和年份，不能填成同名文章或引用文献的编号。
分子类型
从现有词条选择；非空分类至少有一项“主要类型”，补充特征可多选。如大环抑制剂选“小分子抑制剂”＋“大环类”，变构抑制剂选“小分子抑制剂”＋“变构调节”。不重复选同一词条；新选“其他／待明确”须说明原因。
作用方式
记录来源支持的作用机制，分清直接证据与推测；不把分子类型标签当作机制已证实的依据。
研究靶点与关联基因
核对靶点名称、研究角色、物种、基因符号及 UniProt / NCBI Gene 编号。主要靶点、选择性对照、脱靶检测、机制相关和生物标志物分别判断；不能把检测面板全当主要靶点，也不能凭缩写猜基因或物种。
优化目标／疾病与应用方向
区分作者想改善的性质与实际达到的结果；区分研究应用方向与已经证实的治疗效果。每项都保留依据。
en: Module
Checks
PMID / PMCID
PMID is numeric; PMCID includes the PMC prefix. Open links and match title, DOI and year; do not use another paper’s or a cited reference’s identifier.
Molecule types

Choose existing terms. A nonempty classification needs at least one primary type; supplementary features may be combined. A macrocyclic inhibitor uses Small-molecule inhibitor + Macrocyclic; an allosteric inhibitor uses Small-molecule inhibitor + Allosteric modulation. Avoid duplicate terms; explain newly selected Other / Unclear entries.
Mechanisms
Record source-supported mechanisms and distinguish evidence from hypotheses. A molecule-type label alone does not establish a mechanism.
Targets and associated genes

Check target name, study role, organism, gene symbol and UniProt / NCBI Gene identifiers. Distinguish primary targets, selectivity controls, off-target assays, mechanistic targets and biomarkers. Do not classify an entire assay panel as primary targets or infer genes/species from abbreviations.
Optimization goals / disease context
Distinguish intended property improvements from achieved results, and intended applications from demonstrated therapeutic effects. Keep support for each entry.

blocks.zh: 左右模块有各自的滚动区域，不能只核对第一屏。展开“依据与说明／编号与依据”阅读原文摘录；编辑时还可展开“原文摘录”。“查看原图区域”仅在有匹配当前主文 PDF 的定位信息时显示；没有截图按钮时，按“打开对应原文”或来源链接核对，不能把文字摘录当作已经看过原图。补充材料要写材料名称及页码，外部来源要保留链接；引文忠实保留原文，解释另写在依据说明。
blocks.en: The side-by-side modules scroll independently; review beyond the first visible screen. Expand evidence or identifier details to read quotations; the editor also has a source-quotation section. View source region appears only when crop coordinates match the current main PDF. Without that button, use the source-page or source link; reading a quotation is not viewing the source image. Identify supplementary material and page, retain external links, and keep quotations faithful while putting explanations in the rationale.

blocks.zh: PDB ID 支持传统四字符与 pdb_ 前缀扩展格式；ATP 等三字符配体代码不是 PDB ID。区分本文结构、引用结构和用途待核对，记录页码及上下文，仅在来源明确配对时关联 Compound。
blocks.en: PDB IDs support the traditional four-character and extended pdb_ formats; a three-character ligand code such as ATP is not a PDB ID. Distinguish structures from this work, cited structures and unknown usage; retain pages and context, and link a Compound only when the source explicitly pairs it with the structure.

zh: 点击“编辑基础信息”填写原文 Abstract；来源和检查状态位于“书目追溯信息”。摘要翻译或自己的概括不能替换原文摘要。“已提取”不等于 reviewer 已确认；“已检查，未找到”或“待核对”要说明范围与原因。
在正文、结构解析方法和 Accession Codes 中查找 Protein Data Bank / PDB，逐个记录明确编号。先确认它是结构编号，不是配体三字码、基因编号或实验耗材型号。
判断用途：本文新测定并沉积的实验结构填“本文结构”；下载已有坐标做 docking、结构比较或分子置换填“引用结构”；无法判断时填“用途待核对”并说明。
填写 PDF 实际页码和来源上下文。只有原文明确结构与分子身份配对时才填关联 Compound；对接了化合物 7 并不证明该 PDB 晶体里就是 7。
同一编号多次出现通常合并说明用途和补充页码。原文编号或蛋白名冲突时保留来源并写需核对，不静默改成自己觉得更合理的编号。
en: Use Edit bibliography for the source Abstract; its source and check status are under bibliographic traceability details. A translation or summary cannot replace the original abstract. Extracted does not mean reviewer-confirmed; explain scope and reasons for Not found or Needs review.
Search text, structure methods and Accession Codes for Protein Data Bank / PDB. Distinguish structure accessions from three-character ligand codes, gene accessions and equipment codes.
Use this-work for newly determined/deposited experimental structures; cited-structure for existing coordinates used in docking, comparison or molecular replacement. Explain uncertain usage.
Record the physical PDF page and context. Associate a Compound only with explicit source support: docking compound 7 does not establish that the deposited crystal ligand is 7.
Usually consolidate repeated mentions of one ID with uses and additional page references. Retain and flag source conflicts rather than silently substituting a more plausible accession.

blocks.zh: 查过正文但没有找到编号，准确写法是“已检查当前 PDF，未见明确 PDB 编号；SI 尚未检查”（如果确实如此）。空白字段只表示未记录，不能拿空白当作“作者没有报告”的证据。
blocks.en: If no accession is found, state the actual scope, such as “No explicit PDB accession found in this PDF; SI not checked,” when true. An empty field alone does not establish source absence.

sections.title_zh: 14 · 已查看 ≠ 已确认：理解页面状态
sections.zh: 只在 Compound 和 Lineage 两层记录已查看。主动选择 Compound 或 Lineage（含打开其 Edge 详情）后记录；后台加载和浏览整张图不批量确认所有组。Compound 包含基本信息、结构、来源图、活性及关联证据；Lineage 包含成员、成员化合物内容、Edge 及关联证据。相关内容变化使所属组已读失效，无关组不受影响；可以标记未读。只显示这两类计数，结构、Activity、Edge、Evidence 不再分别打勾。文章信息保留人工区段确认；无归属 Evidence 在证据库查看，由最终整篇确认覆盖。旧细粒度回执不自动升级为整组阅读，需要重新打开当前组。颜色仅辅助，文字为准。已查看不是科学批准，不清空“需核对”，不自动确认 Structure/Edge。无内容区段仍需明确未报告，最后须人工勾选整篇确认并提交，Admin 再审批。
sections.en: Viewing is recorded only for Compound and Lineage groups. Explicitly select a Compound or Lineage (including opening its Edge details); background loading or viewing the graph does not mark every group. A Compound includes its fields, structure, source images, activities and linked evidence. A Lineage includes members, their Compound content, edges and linked evidence. Related edits invalidate the affected groups; unrelated groups remain unchanged. Groups can be marked unread. Only these two counts are shown; Structures, Activities, Edges and Evidence have no separate viewing checkmarks. Article information retains its manual section confirmation. Unassigned Evidence remains in the evidence library and is covered by the final whole-paper confirmation. Historical narrow-scope receipts do not establish group viewing: reopen the current group. Text accompanies colors. Viewed is not scientific approval, never clears verification hints, and never confirms Structures or Edges. Empty sections still need an explicit not-reported disposition. Final human confirmation, submission and Admin approval remain required.

zh: 页面信号
代表什么
你还需要做什么
Compound / Lineage 已查看
系统记录你主动打开过当前版本的这一组
核对组内全部相关内容；自动记录并不证明你已理解
⚠ 需核对
该条目有明确疑点；点击图标展开文字
对照来源解决问题后编辑清空提示；阅读/确认不会自动清除
draft / 待审核
科学处理尚未完成
判断当前结构/关系/文章标注是否可确认
reviewer_confirmed / 已确认
reviewer 明确作出的科学判断
修改内容后重新检查其依据
unresolved / 待解决
问题尚未解决，已明确记录
说明问题并交接负责人，不能等同已正确
区段未报告
审核后判断该区段在来源中未报告
说明依据；不能用来绕过未做完的工作
en: Signal
Meaning
Your remaining responsibility
Compound / Lineage viewed
You explicitly opened this group at its current content version
Inspect all relevant contents; the automatic receipt does not prove understanding
⚠ Needs verification
A specific issue is attached; click to expand
Resolve against the source and explicitly clear the hint; viewing/confirmation does not clear it
draft
Scientific disposition is not complete
Decide whether the structure, relationship or annotation is supported
reviewer_confirmed
An explicit scientific judgment by the reviewer
Recheck support after content changes
unresolved
An explicitly recorded open problem
Explain and hand off; this is not confirmation of correctness
Section not reported
Source absence determined through review
Document why; do not use to bypass unfinished work

blocks.zh: 现在只记录 Compound 和 Lineage 两级已查看。Compound 组包括结构、来源图、Activity 和关联证据；Lineage 组包括成员、成员内容、Edge 和证据。相关内容修改会使相应组需重新查看，布局调整不等于科学修改。不要为把计数刷满而快速逐条点开。
blocks.en: Viewing is tracked only at Compound and Lineage level. A Compound group includes structures, source images, Activities and linked evidence; a Lineage group includes members, member content, Edges and evidence. Relevant edits invalidate viewing, while layout changes do not change the science. Do not click through simply to fill the count.

blocks.zh: 核对当前 Lineage 关系图后，可点击“一键确认 Draft Edge”，无需逐条进入 Edge。仅将当前 Lineage 的 Draft Edge 改为已确认，保留“无法判定”和核对提示，并记录当前 Lineage 已查看；不改变 Compound 结构或节点角色。整次操作可一次撤销或重做；内容改变或撤销恢复后，受影响条目需重新查看。
blocks.en: After checking the current Lineage graph, click “Confirm all Draft Edges” without opening each Edge. Only Draft Edges in this Lineage become confirmed; unresolved statuses and review hints remain. The current Lineage is marked viewed, while Compound structures and member roles stay unchanged. The batch supports one-step undo and redo; changed or restored records need to be viewed again.

sections.title_zh: 15 · 提交前：逐条处理阻断项
sections.zh: 提交会冻结当前内容，交给 Admin 审批。你的最后一次整篇确认仍是必需步骤；程序检查通过也不能代替源文审核。
sections.en: Submission freezes the current content for Admin review. Your final whole-paper confirmation is still required; passing automated checks does not replace source review.

zh: 完成 Compound、Lineage 以及相关结构/关系/文章标注的核对后，进入“检查与提交”，点击“重新检查”。
有未查看组时点对应条目回去检查；修改了组内内容后，再查看当前版本。文章信息仍需人工区段确认。无归属 Evidence 也要在证据库检查，并纳入最终整篇确认。
逐个打开阻断项，根据实际原因处理：例如结构仍是 draft、Edge 尚未审核、Lineage 角色不完整、文章标注缺依据或查看记录过期。不要为了通过检查统一改为已确认。
源文确实未报告的空区段明确选择未报告。对 unresolved 项和范围限制，在 Reviewer note 中交代；若系统允许提交带未决项，也必须让 Admin 知道，提交不代表问题已解决。
复查整篇覆盖、结构来源、Activity 单位、Lineage 逻辑和所有疑点。确认可以交接后，人工勾选整篇确认并点击“提交给 Admin 审批”。
提交成功后内容被冻结；Admin 可以批准或退回修改。批准后才进入正式文章页面。需要修正已提交内容时按退回流程处理，不通过重复新建文章绕过。
en: After reviewing groups and their scientific dispositions, open Review & submit and choose Recheck.

Open unread groups and inspect the current content after edits. Article information retains manual section confirmation. Check unassigned Evidence in the library as part of the final whole-paper review.
Open each blocker and fix the actual issue: a draft structure/edge, incomplete Lineage roles, unsupported article annotation or stale viewing receipt. Never bulk-confirm just to pass.

Explicitly mark genuinely unreported empty sections. Explain unresolved issues and coverage limits in Reviewer note. If submission with unresolved items is permitted, make them clear to Admin; submission does not resolve them.
Recheck coverage, structure sources, Activity units, Lineage logic and uncertainties. When ready for handoff, manually check the final confirmation and submit to Admin.
A successful submission is frozen. Admin can approve or request changes; publication follows approval. Use the return-for-changes workflow for corrections rather than creating a duplicate paper.

zh: 提交后的情形
如何处理
退回修改
退回修改会恢复同一工作区的编辑状态，已保存内容、人工说明及未变化的确认不会被清空；不需要从空白重新做整篇。先查看退回原因，再复核本次改动、依赖项和失效的查看记录，提交前仍需完成整篇确认。
AI 补填
AI 补填的文章信息不作为 reviewer 的人工修改计数，但仍属于需要核对的当前内容。提交后发生补充时，需完成相关复核并重新提交，不能把旧提交的审批当作对新增内容的批准。
重新提交
Admin 按真实的 reviewer 提交版本查看提交时间、意见与版本差异；仅保存草稿不会生成新提交。重新提交时在 Reviewer note 写清处理结果与未决问题。
已发布文章的修订
已发布文章的补充修订在新一轮批准前保留原发布版；新提交获批后成为当前发布版，旧发布记录保留。草稿修改或退回本身不会直接替换已发布内容。
en: After submission
What to do
Returned for changes

Return for changes reopens the same workspace without clearing saved content, human notes or unchanged confirmations. You do not restart from an empty paper. Read the return reason, recheck changes, dependencies and invalidated viewing receipts, then complete the whole-paper confirmation before submitting again.
AI supplements

AI article supplements do not count as human Reviewer edits, but remain current content requiring review. Additions after submission require relevant checks and resubmission; approval of an older submission cannot approve new content.
Resubmission

Admin navigates actual Reviewer submissions with timestamps, notes and version comparisons; saving a draft alone creates no new submission. Explain completed corrections and unresolved issues in the Reviewer note when resubmitting.
Revising a published paper

For a revision of a published paper, the existing publication remains current until the new submission is approved. Approval makes the new version current and retains the old publication record. Draft edits or return for changes do not directly replace published content.

blocks.zh: 教学示例故意保留一个待处理项：点击问题定位并核对，完成前不要勾选整篇确认。
blocks.en: This teaching example intentionally retains a blocker. Open it and resolve the issue before final whole-paper confirmation.

blocks.zh: 文章存在重大问题时，使用“反馈文章问题并提交”，填写必填的问题说明。可在未全部查看或确认时提交；系统冻结当前内容、查看进度和未完成清单。Admin 可退回处理，这类提交不能直接批准发布；解决问题后须按正常流程审核并重新提交。
blocks.en: For major article problems, use “Report an article problem and submit” with a required explanation. It can freeze incomplete or unconfirmed work, including viewing progress and blockers. An Admin can return it for follow-up; it cannot be published directly. Resolve the issue, complete normal review and resubmit.

sections.title_zh: 16 · 常见问题：先判断，再操作
sections.zh: 科学记录保存使用 Workspace 版本；发生冲突时重新读取并核对，不覆盖别人的修改。布局有独立版本，已读不增加科学版本。需要核对的记录可保持提示与草稿；不要为通过提交检查而随意确认。
sections.en: Scientific edits use the Workspace version; on conflict reload and reconcile instead of overwriting others. Layout has its own revision; viewing does not increment scientific versions. Keep hints and drafts when unresolved; never confirm merely to pass submission checks.

zh: 遇到的情况
建议处理
新增 Node 找不到编号
检查是否选错文章、已是该组成员，或 Compound 尚未录入；不要重复新建。
一组图散成几块
先区分布局与科学关系；查漏边/错端点/错误分组，缺来源时保留疑点。
活性截图截错行
回 PDF 对照行标签、表头、单位、脚注；修正页码/区域后重新核对实际图片。
保存提示版本冲突
保留未保存的文字，重新读取最新记录并逐项比较；避免多个窗口同时编辑同篇。
有 ⚠ 但看不到说明
点击图标展开；只阅读不会清空提示。
已读又变未读
相关内容已更改，重新核对当前版本；不是让你重复确认旧内容。
不能提交
打开检查页逐项定位原因；区分未查看、draft、无来源、角色问题与真正未报告。
按钮只读或无法编辑
检查账号角色和任务状态：Admin 查看或已提交/批准可能只读；联系负责人走正常修改流程。
不懂杂环、立体化学或实验指标
记录化合物编号、PDF 页码、具体位置和问题，交给负责人；不要猜测或伪造确定性。
Source PDF 打不开或提示暂时不可用
先重试；仍失败时记录 paper ID、题名及错误提示交给负责人。来源无法核对时保留待核对状态，不为修复访问而删除或重复新建文章。
en: Situation
Recommended action
Label missing from Add Node
Check paper selection, existing membership and whether the Compound exists; avoid duplicates.
Diagram split into fragments
Distinguish layout from scientific relationships; inspect missing edges, wrong endpoints or grouping and retain source gaps.
Activity crop shows wrong row
Check row label, heading, unit and footnote; fix page/region and inspect the actual generated image.
Version conflict on save
Preserve unsaved text, reload current data and reconcile changes. Avoid concurrent editing of one paper in multiple windows.
Warning icon without text
Click to expand; viewing alone does not clear it.
Viewed becomes unread
Relevant content changed; inspect the current version, not the previous one.
Submission disabled
Locate each blocker: unread, draft, missing support, role issues or genuine source absence.
Read-only controls
Check role and workflow state; Admin viewing or submitted/approved content may be read-only. Ask for the normal change workflow.
Unfamiliar ring, stereochemistry or assay
Record compound label, PDF page, exact location and question for your supervisor; do not guess.
Source PDF fails to open or is temporarily unavailable

Retry; if it persists, report paper ID, title and the error to the supervisor. Keep source-dependent items pending when the source cannot be checked; do not delete or duplicate the paper to fix access.

sections.title_zh: 17 · 五分钟自测：能说清理由才算会
sections.zh: 以下案例完全虚构，可在纸上回答，不需要在实际数据库创建。先想答案，再展开解释。
sections.en: This case is entirely fictional. Answer on paper without creating real database records. Think first, then expand the explanation.

blocks.zh: 假设论文报告 7a、7b、7c 三个同骨架分子，分别为 Me、OMe、F 取代；同一 assay 的 IC50 为 120、40、15 nM。作者明确写“以 7a 为参考比较 7b 和 7c；因 7b 暴露量更好，选择 7b 做体内验证”。对照 Q 仅用于初始活性比较；合成路线另有编号中间体 6。
blocks.en: Suppose compounds 7a, 7b and 7c share a scaffold with Me, OMe and F substituents. Their IC50 values in the same assay are 120, 40 and 15 nM. The authors explicitly compare 7b and 7c against 7a and select 7b for in vivo studies because of better exposure. Control Q appears only in the initial comparison, and synthesis includes labeled intermediate 6.

zh.question: 哪些分子进入 Compound？
zh.answer: 7a、7b、7c、Q，以及中间体 6，只要各自有来源可确定的结构。6 没有活性也应收录；Q 不需要为了进清单而强行连入优化图。

en.question: Which identities belong in Compound?
en.answer: 7a, 7b, 7c, Q and intermediate 6, provided each has a source-determinable structure. Missing activity does not exclude 6; Q does not need an artificial optimization edge.

zh.question: 应该画 7a→7b→7c 吗？
zh.answer: 不应仅按编号串联。这里有明确共同参考物，可记录 7a→7b、7a→7c 的 SAR 比较；实际合成关系另看 Scheme，不能由这些 IC50 推断。

en.question: Should the graph be 7a→7b→7c?
en.answer: Do not chain by numbering. The explicit common reference supports SAR comparisons 7a→7b and 7a→7c. Synthetic relationships require the Scheme and cannot be inferred from these IC50 values.

zh.question: 谁是论文优选？
zh.answer: 7b：作者明确选择它进行体内验证，有暴露量的理由。7c 的 IC50 最低也不能取代作者选择。7a 的研究起点仍需确认来源是否明确把它作为本研究/系列起点；“参考物”本身不总是足够。

en.question: Which compound is prioritized by the paper?
en.answer: 7b, explicitly advanced for its exposure. The lowest IC50 of 7c does not override the authors’ choice. Confirm that 7a is actually presented as the study/series starting point; being a reference alone is not always enough.

zh.question: 看到 7c 的 IC50 <15 nM 应该怎么填？
zh.answer: Metric=IC50，Operator=<，Value=15，Unit=nM；检查该数值的行列和脚注，保留条件。不能记成等于 15 或 0。

en.question: How would IC50 <15 nM for 7c be entered?
en.answer: Metric=IC50, Operator=<, Value=15, Unit=nM; check the row, column and footnotes and retain conditions. Do not record it as exactly 15 or zero.

zh.question: 把所有组点到已读，可以直接提交吗？
zh.answer: 不行。已查看不表示科学核对完成。还要处理结构/Edge/文章标注状态、来源问题和检查阻断项，再做人工整篇确认。

en.question: Can you submit after clicking every group to viewed?
en.answer: No. Viewed does not establish scientific review. Resolve structure/edge/annotation dispositions, source issues and submission blockers, then give final whole-paper confirmation.

zh.question: Compound 3 在前图是 terminal，又被选作下一批优化起点，是否矛盾？
zh.answer: 不矛盾。terminal 只指前图末端；若有新基准和新一批优化，可在后图复用同一个 Compound 3 并设为 root，描述衔接与依据。若只是短链，可留在同图作 intermediate。枢纽分子不自动等于论文优选；作者选择另核对。

en.question: Can Compound 3 be terminal in one graph and start the next optimization batch?
en.answer: Yes. Terminal means a local endpoint. If 3 becomes the baseline for a new batch, reuse the same Compound as root in the next graph and document the connection and support. A short chain can stay together with 3 as intermediate. A subsequent start is not automatically paper-prioritized; check author choice separately.

sections.title_en: 18 · Completion criteria and asking for help
sections.zh: 一份好的审核结果应让下一位读者找到来源、理解判断，并清楚知道哪些地方仍待解决。
sections.en: A good review lets the next reader find the source, understand the judgment and see what remains unresolved.

zh: 编号覆盖：原文可识别且结构可确定的分子已逐个核对，缺口和 SI 范围限制有说明。
身份与数据：结构连接/环系/立体化学、Activity 指标/数值/单位/条件，与来源逐项一致。
关系与角色：SAR/合成分开，分组和 Edge 有依据；组内角色与文章级作者选择分别判断。
可追溯性：页码、引文和实际截图可定位；所有提示与未决问题写得具体，不被无依据地清除。

groups.note_en: –CH₂CH₃

groups.note_en: –CH₂CH₂CH₃ / –CH(CH₃)₂; attachment differs.

groups.note_zh: 分别为正丁基、异丁基、仲丁基、叔丁基；不能互换。
groups.note_en: n-Butyl, isobutyl, sec-butyl, tert-butyl; not interchangeable.

groups.note_en: –C₆H₅; attached directly through the aromatic ring.

groups.note_zh: –CH₂C₆H₅；比 Ph 多一个亚甲基。
groups.note_en: –CH₂C₆H₅; one methylene more than Ph.

groups.note_zh: 不是标准苄基或苯基缩写；不得自动纠正为 Bn/Ph，先核对原文定义或印刷。
groups.note_en: Not a standard benzyl or phenyl abbreviation. Check the source definition or typography; do not silently replace with Bn/Ph.

groups.zh: 甲氧基 / 乙氧基 / 苄氧基
groups.note_zh: 通过 O 连接；不同于 Me/Et/Bn。
groups.note_en: Attached through O; distinct from Me/Et/Bn.

groups.note_zh: –C(=O)CH₃；OAc 为乙酰氧基，保留连接原子。
groups.note_en: –C(=O)CH₃; OAc is acetoxy. Preserve the attachment atom.

groups.note_zh: 常见氨基保护基；记录结构中实际连接位置。
groups.note_en: Common amine protecting group; preserve the actual attachment.

groups.note_zh: 保护基，不等于 Bn。
groups.note_en: Protecting group; not Bn.

groups.note_zh: 保护基；按图核对连接。
groups.note_en: Protecting group; verify attachment in the drawing.

groups.zh: 对甲苯磺酰基 / 甲磺酰基 / 三氟甲磺酰基
groups.note_zh: 与 OTs/OMs/OTf 的连接原子不同；注意盐和共价基团的区别。
groups.note_en: Distinguish from OTs/OMs/OTf and distinguish salts from covalent groups.

groups.note_zh: 不是唯一结构；结合具体定义和取代位置。
groups.note_en: Not a unique structure; resolve the definition and substitution positions.

groups.note_zh: 只有在该化合物的取代表中明确后才能展开。
groups.note_en: Expand only when assigned in the substituent table for that compound.

groups.zh: 邻位 / 间位 / 对位
groups.note_zh: 二取代苯环通常对应 1,2 / 1,3 / 1,4；仍核对编号体系。
groups.note_en: Usually 1,2 / 1,3 / 1,4 on disubstituted benzene; verify numbering.

groups.zh: 氢 / 氟 / 氯 / 溴 / 碘
groups.note_zh: 元素符号区分大小写；Cl 不是 C 和 I。
groups.note_en: Element capitalization matters; Cl is not C plus I.

groups.zh: 三氟甲基 / 氰基 / 硝基
groups.note_zh: 核对连接原子与完整价态；不能只按字符数画结构。
groups.note_en: Check attachment and valence; do not draw by character count.

groups.note_zh: c- 表示环；不同于直链或支链 Pr/Bu。
groups.note_en: c- denotes a ring, distinct from acyclic Pr/Bu.

groups.zh: 常指吡啶或吡啶基，依原文定义
groups.note_zh: 必须核对 2-/3-/4- 连接位和 N 的位置；不可只凭 Py 推断唯一结构。
groups.note_en: Resolve 2-/3-/4- attachment and N position; Py alone is not a unique structure.

groups.note_zh: 分别核对硅上取代基及连接位置；保护/脱保护会改变实际结构。
groups.note_en: Check silicon substituents and attachment; protection/deprotection changes the structure.
